caption: The image shows five rectangular swatches of fabric arranged in two rows on a plain, off-white background. The top row has three swatches: the leftmost is pinkish-red with a repeating pattern of cream-colored circles containing small tree-like designs with green details; the middle one is a darker brown with a repeating pattern of cream and red circular motifs; the rightmost is a dark green with yellow and red oval leaf-like forms spread across. The bottom row has two swatches: the left one is dark brown with a pattern of small, light-beige squares and pink-red flower or bow shapes; the right one has a blue background with a repeating pattern of yellow and orange shapes resembling stylized flowers or suns. There is a handwritten signature on the lower right-hand side of the page.
